$comment: Authored-body manifest (PRD R4'). The voice-prose boundary, made mechanical:
a concept whose Markdown file has a non-empty body flips indexable ONLY when its
slug has an entry under `approved` below — a committed, human-approved record.
An agent-committed body WITHOUT a manifest entry must NOT flip indexability
(asserted by tests/concept-index-state.test.mjs). Agents never edit this file.
HOW TO APPROVE AN AUTHORED BODY (human only):
1. Stephanie writes the body in src/content/concepts/<slug>.md (below the frontmatter).
3. Both changes land in one human-authored commit. The page becomes indexable on the
next build; src/lib/concepts/indexState.ts cross-checks body presence AND this entry.
A manifest entry without a non-empty body does nothing; a body without an entry does nothing.
